user_goal: Make Plotkeeper self-contained by including SpecSwarm and every required skill dependency, with EKG attribution for SpecSwarm, then publish the verified correction.

baseline.protection_evidence: Public main, local main, and origin/main are identical and clean; both public Actions workflows passed.
baseline.selection_reason: Current publicly attested Plotkeeper release before completing the bundled dependency closure.

resources: Local isolated Codex installation roots under Z:/Plotkeeper/runtime/qa
Installed Plotkeeper Codex integration for post-review verification
semantic_changes: Bundle the EKG-owned SpecSwarm, production-goal-contract, and production-goal-review skills in the repository.
Bundle the complete upstream MSW, MSW Hook, and Timebox packages under their original CC BY 4.0 attribution instead of requiring a marketplace fetch.
Install every bundled skill and hook from the repository while preserving unrelated local configuration and adaptive timing history.
Document bundled versus platform-provided requirements and prove a network-independent isolated install.
Do not change Plotkeeper runtime behavior, dashboard behavior, package metadata, public license, or release verifier.
Do not remove or weaken existing hooks, guard enforcement, tests, or third-party attribution.
Do not include caches, bytecode, secrets, personal datasets, machine-specific receipts, or calibration history.

invariants: A clean isolated installation succeeds using only files in this repository and the installed Codex/Python platform.
SpecSwarm and both EKG governance skills are installed as complete skill directories.
MSW, Timebox, and MSW Hook are distributed completely and retain Slopware Engineer attribution and CC BY 4.0 terms.
Existing adaptive-execution history preservation and unrelated-hook preservation remain green.
All repository tests and public release enforcement remain green.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Running the repository installer supplies SpecSwarm and its complete skill dependency closure without downloading skill code.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: The installer may not merely mention, assume, or fetch a required skill from another marketplace.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: A new Plotkeeper user installing the Codex integration from a clean isolated Codex home.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Ownership and licensing are accurate: SpecSwarm and governance skills are EKG-owned; Slopware packages retain upstream attribution and CC BY 4.0.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Plotkeeper may not claim ownership of Slopware material or describe bundled dependencies as separately fetched.

proof_requirements.claim: The transitive skill dependency inventory is complete.
proof_requirements.required_environment: Repository and canonical local source skills
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Compare every referenced skill, script, hook, and reference file to the bundled manifest and installed output.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: No required skill artifact is absent or marketplace-only.

proof_requirements.claim: A clean offline-style isolated install contains and validates every dependency.
proof_requirements.required_environment: Fresh Z-drive Codex home with plugin network operations disabled
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Run installer in bundled-only mode, compare manifests and hashes, validate hooks, and run the full test suite.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: Every bundled skill/hook is present byte-for-byte and existing configuration is preserved.

proof_requirements.claim: Notices and docs accurately identify EKG and Slopware ownership/license boundaries.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Review NOTICE, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES, README, integration docs, and copied package license metadata.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: Every bundled component has an accurate owner and license statement.

release_requirements.required_receipt: Clean exact candidate, complete dependency manifest, isolated install proof, full tests, attribution audit, rollback path, and public target reconciliation.

stop_conditions: Any required dependency remains external-only or uninstalled.
Any copied upstream file lacks required attribution or license coverage.
Any isolated install, manifest comparison, hook merge, or repository test fails.
Any forbidden path changes or secret/cache/history enters Git.
Independent DEPLOY_READY verdict is not PASS.
known_discrepancies: The public installer currently fetches MSW/Timebox/MSW Hook from an external marketplace and does not include or install SpecSwarm or its EKG governance dependencies.
